name: Exp_MFI
summary: This EA trades based on the Money Flow Index (MFI) indicator, entering long positions when MFI is oversold and exiting when overbought, and vice versa for short positions. It uses fixed lot sizing and implements a simple momentum-based strategy with customizable MFI periods and threshold levels. The EA applies the MFI oscillator to identify potential reversal points driven by volume-weighted price action.
summary_zh: 该EA基于资金流量指标(MFI)进行交易，在MFI超卖时做多、超买时平仓，做空则相反。采用固定手数下单，利用MFI震荡器识别由成交量加权价格行为驱动的潜在反转点，实现简单的动量反转策略。
strategy_analysis: 该EA使用资金流量指标(MFI)作为唯一的交易信号源，属于典型的动量反转策略。入场条件为：当MFI从超卖区域（默认阈值以下）向上突破时开多单，当MFI从超买区域（默认阈值以上）向下突破时开空单。出场条件依靠MFI到达对侧极端区域触发平仓信号，或使用止损/止盈参数控制单笔风险。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未实现动态仓位调整或基于资金的百分比风险管理。资金管理方面较为简陋，仅依赖用户手动设定手数大小，缺乏根据账户余额或波动率自适应调节的机制。整体策略逻辑清晰但单一，缺乏多时间框架确认和过滤机制，在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA uses the Money Flow Index (MFI) as its sole trading signal source, implementing a classic momentum reversal strategy. Entry conditions are: go long when MFI crosses above the oversold threshold and go short when MFI crosses below the overbought threshold. Exit conditions rely on MFI reaching the opposite extreme zone to trigger position closure, or using stop-loss/take-profit parameters to control per-trade risk. Position sizing employs a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment or percentage-based money management. Money management is relatively primitive, depending solely on user-specified lot sizes without adaptive mechanisms based on account balance or volatility. The overall strategy logic is clear but singular, lacking multi-timeframe confirmation and filtering mechanisms, which makes it prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy markets.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调试
MFI结合了价格和成交量信息，比纯价格指标更具参考价值
参数可配置性强，用户可自定义MFI周期和超买超卖阈值
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
MFI incorporates both price and volume information, providing more reference value than pure price indicators
High configurability with user-adjustable MFI period and overbought/oversold thresholds
cons: 缺乏多时间框架确认，单一指标容易产生虚假信号
固定手数下单，缺乏动态资金管理和风险控制机制
没有防重复开仓检查和新K线判断，可能同一信号反复开仓
缺少点差过滤，在点差较大时入场成本高影响盈利
策略过于单一，未结合趋势过滤器区分震荡市和趋势市
cons_en: Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, a single indicator easily generates false signals
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic money management or risk control mechanisms
No duplicate order check or new bar detection, potentially opening multiple positions on the same signal
Missing spread filter, high spread entries increase costs and hurt profitability
Strategy is overly simplistic, lacks trend filter to distinguish ranging and trending markets
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势确认，例如在H1趋势方向下才执行M15的MFI信号
实现基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位管理替代固定手数
添加新K线判断防止同一根K线上重复开仓，并加入点差过滤机制
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend confirmation, e.g., only execute M15 MFI signals aligned with H1 trend direction
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance percentage instead of fixed lots
Add new bar detection to prevent duplicate entries on the same bar, and incorporate a spread filter

risk_points: 固定手数无资金管理，大仓位可能导致单笔亏损过大
缺少重复开仓检查，可能在同一信号上叠加多个仓位放大风险
止损默认为0，若用户未设置则完全依赖MFI信号平仓，存在大幅亏损可能
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing without money management, large positions can cause excessive single-trade losses
No duplicate order check, potentially stacking multiple positions on the same signal amplifying risk
Stop-loss defaults to 0, if user doesn't set it then relies entirely on MFI signal for exit, risking large drawdowns

The EA applies the MFI oscillator to identify potential reversal points driven by volume-weighted price action.
